description: Principal PM-posture skill that writes what a product turned out to be, once its foundation has settled — the project card's architecture-determined fields (Languages:, Language roots:, Test command:) and the product's README.md, both derived from the settled document set. Requires Principal PM posture (halts if invoked outside a principal-pm session or the principal-pm subagent). It runs after the FDR, ADR and NFDR have landed and before anything is built, and it is the step that makes the skeleton launcher runnable — product-skeleton reads the card this writes, so this runs first and never the other way round. Writes two files and nothing else: no code, no document under the product's docs/, and no skeleton. Use when a product's foundation step has settled and the card or the README has not caught up, when the card is missing Language roots: or Languages:, when a README still calls a defined product a proposal, or when someone asks to set a product up after foundation. Do not use for scaffolding a new project's management folder (project-stamp), placing the language frames (the product-skeleton launcher), the definition documents (product-prd, product-srs, product-uxd, product-sdd), the foundation records (product-fdr, product-architecture), or cutting seeds from them (seeds-from-product-docs).
